commands.label: 20261118-successor-current-handoff-check
argv:
import ast
import copy
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit

REPO = Path("<checkout>")
STORE = Path("<store>")
ROOT = STORE / "artifacts/20261117-sti108-baseline"
EVIDENCE = REPO / "evidence/20261117-sti108-baseline/run.json"


def sha256(path):
    with path.open("rb") as stream:
        return hashlib.file_digest(stream, "sha256").hexdigest()


data = json.loads(EVIDENCE.read_text())
assert data["status"] == "blocked"
assert data["schema_version"] == 1
assert EVIDENCE.stat().st_size < 200_000
assert "/Users/" not in EVIDENCE.read_text()
assert not re.search(r"github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]+|gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]+|lin_api_[A-Za-z0-9]+|BEGIN .*PRIVATE KEY", EVIDENCE.read_text())
assert data["inputs"]["source_commit"] == "209222b2f7fbd6a30257b0e064d3f4df18e23692"
assert data["inputs"]["configuration_commit"] == data["inputs"]["source_commit"]
assert data["inputs"]["test_commit"] == "b5f1902618e0c23f1be38fac8c690ae91b7aab72"
for group, commit_key in (("source_file_sha256", "source_commit"), ("test_file_sha256", "test_commit")):
    for relative, expected in data["inputs"][group].items():
        source = subprocess.check_output(["git", "-C", str(REPO), "show", data["inputs"][commit_key] + ":" + relative])
        assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == expected == sha256(REPO / relative)
ast.parse((REPO / "tests/boot-reference.py").read_text())
commands = {item["label"]: item for item in data["commands"]}
assert len(commands) == len(data["commands"]) == 61
for item in commands.values():
    path = STORE / "logs" / (item["label"] + ".log")
    assert path.stat().st_size == item["log_size"]
    assert sha256(path) == item["log_sha256"]
    duration = (datetime.fromisoformat(item["finished_at"]) - datetime.fromisoformat(item["started_at"])).total_seconds()
    assert abs(duration - item["elapsed_seconds"]) < 0.000001
    if item["outcome"] in ("command_succeeded", "expected_negative_control"):
        assert item["exit_code"] == item["expected_exit_code"]
    else:
        assert item["exit_code"] != item["expected_exit_code"]

results = data["results"]
assert results["image_build"]["executed_tasks"] == 4921
assert results["image_build"]["tasks_not_rerun"] == 0
assert len(results["image_build"]["warnings"]) == 4
assert len(results["installed_packages"]) == 39
assert results["boot_check"]["status"] == "passed"
assert results["boot_check"]["originals_unchanged"]
assert results["wrong_library_negative_control"]["negative_expected_exit"] == 1
assert results["wrong_library_negative_control"]["negative_actual_exit"] == 1
negative = (STORE / "logs/sti-108-boot-rejects-wrong-library.log").read_text()
assert "RuntimeError: Guest library differs from the built package/rootfs" in negative
assert '"originals_after"' in negative
assert results["existing_component_patch_order"] == []
assert results["component_source_worktree_clean"]
assert results["cve_reproduction"] == "not_run" and results["repair"] == "not_applied"
assert results["ptest_suites"] == "not_run" and results["release"] == "not_published"
assert data["timing"]["active_engineering_seconds"] is None
assert data["timing"]["elapsed_image_build_seconds"] == 5366.709314
assert data["timing"]["elapsed_committed_boot_check_seconds"] == 15.462019
assert results["resources"]["host_free_space_sample_count"] == 357
assert results["resources"]["host_minimum_sampled_free_bytes"] >= 25 * 1024**3
assert results["resources"]["resource_monitor_exit_code"] == 1
assert results["resources"]["peak_memory_bytes"] is None

inventory_path = STORE / "logs/sti-108-deploy-source-hashes.log"
inventory = {item["path"]: item for item in map(json.loads, inventory_path.read_text().splitlines())}
verified_files = {}
for item in data["artifacts"]:
    assert item["size"] > 0 and re.fullmatch("[0-9a-f]{64}", item["sha256"])
    assert item["role"]
    if "archive_member" in item:
        source = inventory[item["path"]]
        assert item["archive_member"] == "deploy/" + item["path"]
        assert source["size"] == item["size"] and source["sha256"] == item["sha256"]
    else:
        prefix = "local://firmdura-kirkstone/"
        assert item["locator"].startswith(prefix)
        path = STORE / item["locator"][len(prefix):]
        assert path.stat().st_size == item["size"]
        verified_files[item["path"]] = sha256(path)
        assert verified_files[item["path"]] == item["sha256"]
assert verified_files["deploy.tar"] == results["canonical_artifact_integrity"]["archive_sha256"]
assert verified_files["libwebsockets-task-logs.tar"] == results["component_task_log_integrity"]["archive_sha256"]
assert sha256(inventory_path) == results["canonical_artifact_integrity"]["source_index_sha256"]
assert all(results[key]["status"] == "verified" for key in (
    "canonical_artifact_integrity", "component_task_log_integrity", "supplemental_artifact_integrity",
))

scans = {}
for path in sorted((ROOT / "scans").glob("*-grype.json")):
    report = json.loads(path.read_text())
    configuration = report["descriptor"]["configuration"]
    assert configuration["vex-documents"] == []
    assert configuration["add-cpes-if-none"] is False
    assert not configuration["distro"]
    assert configuration["db"]["auto-update"] is False
    assert configuration["db"]["validate-by-hash-on-start"] is True
    assert configuration["db"]["validate-age"] is True
    assert configuration["db"]["max-allowed-built-age"] == 120 * 3600 * 1_000_000_000
    assert len(configuration["ignore"]) == 4
    assert report["descriptor"]["version"] == "0.122.0"
    assert report["descriptor"]["db"]["status"]["valid"]
    matches = report["matches"] + report.get("ignoredMatches", [])
    expected_ids = ["CVE-2025-1866"] if path.name in (
        "baseline-library-normalized-grype.json", "baseline-built-cpe-grype.json",
    ) else []
    assert sorted(item["vulnerability"]["id"] for item in matches) == expected_ids
    scans[path.name] = report
assert len(scans) == 5
native = copy.deepcopy(scans["baseline-library-native-all-grype.json"]["descriptor"]["configuration"])
normalized = copy.deepcopy(scans["baseline-library-normalized-grype.json"]["descriptor"]["configuration"])
del native["file"], normalized["file"]
assert native == normalized
original = json.loads((ROOT / "deploy/spdx/qemuarm64/recipes/recipe-libwebsockets.spdx.json").read_text())
changed = json.loads((ROOT / "scans/libwebsockets-reference-type-normalized.spdx.json").read_text())
assert original["packages"][0]["externalRefs"][0]["referenceType"] == "http://spdx.org/rdf/references/cpe23Type"
assert changed["packages"][0]["externalRefs"][0]["referenceType"] == "cpe23Type"
changed["packages"][0]["externalRefs"][0]["referenceType"] = original["packages"][0]["externalRefs"][0]["referenceType"]
assert changed == original
assert results["scanner_preflight"]["status"] == "blocked"
assert results["scanner_preflight"]["grype_nvd_affected_packages"] == 0
assert commands["sti-108-scanner-results-summary"]["exit_code"] == 1


mapping = []
for old, new in [("209222b2f7fbd6a30257b0e064d3f4df18e23692", "6799585d26caf7048acd555e4d0d2a74abe5b019"), ("b5f1902618e0c23f1be38fac8c690ae91b7aab72", "d6b528ea5b106f1c26f8f0e26b6fec4ea7728839")]:
    trees = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", old + "^{tree}", new + "^{tree}"], text=True).splitlines()
    assert trees[0] == trees[1]
    mapping.append({"historical_commit": old, "current_main_equivalent": new, "tree": trees[0]})
print(json.dumps({"status":"verified", "scope":"Existing baseline handoff consistency in the successor checkout; no new build or runtime run", "evidence_sha256":sha256(EVIDENCE), "commands":len(commands), "artifacts":len(data["artifacts"]), "installed_packages":len(results["installed_packages"]), "scanner_reports":len(scans), "scanner_preflight":"blocked", "required_cve_matches":0, "source_mapping":mapping}, indent=2))
